# /craft:ci:validate

---

```bash

```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | no | — | Path to workflow file (defaults to .github/workflows/*.yml) |
| `fix` | no | false | Auto-fix common issues |
| `dry-run` | no | false | Preview validation checks without analyzing files |
